items.title: Bitcoin treasury companies: weekly net BTC flows (last 3 months)
items.description: Weekly net bitcoin bought or sold by public treasury companies over the last 3 months (CoinGecko treasury data, weeks ending Sunday): net selling of 9,255 BTC and 13,863 BTC in the weeks to Nov 8 and Nov 15, then +485 BTC in the week to Nov 22.
items.reason: Strategy disclosed only 457 BTC bought in the week to Nov 22 while spending $212M on STRC buybacks, so treasury buying is still a trickle.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Weekly Flows
items.description: US spot bitcoin ETF weekly net flows with the BTC price, Aug 2025 to Nov 20, 2026; the latest week shows -$1.79bn of outflows with BTC at $58,815.
items.reason: ETFs lost another ~$570M on Monday Nov 23 and BTC slipped back toward $60K even as stocks ripped.

items.title: 30-Day rolling Correlation: BTC vs NASDAQ
items.description: 30-day rolling correlation of daily bitcoin and Nasdaq returns since Nov 2024; it recently climbed back near 0.7, among its highest readings in two years.
items.reason: Monday broke the pattern: the Nasdaq had its best day since April 2025 while bitcoin ended roughly flat.

items.title: Price-to-sales then and now: Cisco from 1998 vs Nvidia and Palantir from 2023
items.description: Price-to-sales by week since start: Cisco from Jan 1998 through its dot-com peak and bust vs Nvidia and Palantir from Jan 2023.
items.reason: Nvidia jumped about 31% Monday on Jensen Huang's reinstatement, the biggest one-day market-value gain on record, reviving the bubble comparison.

items.title: Tesla vs the Nasdaq: relative performance (TSLA ÷ Nasdaq Composite, Jan 2019=100)
items.description: Tesla's share price and its performance relative to the Nasdaq Composite (Jan 2019 = 100), weekly since 2019.
items.reason: Tesla rose about 11% Monday in the tech relief rally, beating the Nasdaq's 6.5% gain.
